name: Rathmore Retrievers
tagline: Health-tested retrievers, raised underfoot in a working farmhouse.
about: Rathmore is a small family programme in County Meath. We breed one or two litters a year from fully health-tested parents, raise every puppy in the kitchen with Puppy Culture handling, and stay in touch with our families for the life of the dog. Golden Retrievers today, with a Labrador line planned.
